info.title: shelf
info.summary: An e-book library for CrossPoint e-readers
info.description: Search the library, read reading progress pushed by the reader, and manage shelves. Book ids are index row ids and are renumbered whenever the index is rebuilt, so look one up just before using it. Under Outpost's login gateway requests are already authenticated; otherwise use HTTP Basic with a shelf account (`shelf user add`). The same operations are offered as MCP tools at /mcp.
